g.text: Digital forensics delivers Reyes's personal notes: thirty-seven entries, January to the night he died,
most of them about fuel prices and payroll. Varma drops the printout on your desk. "Somewhere in there
he says what he found. Feed the lot to LANTERN and ask." You paste the whole file into one prompt and
ask. LANTERN answers at once, and with confidence: Reyes never mentions Northwind. You have read the
anonymous envelope. You know that cannot be true.

Reyes says: "Northwind is not a vendor. It has no ships, no staff and no office, only a PO box in Port
Sabran and an account at Sabran Mercantile Bank. No VAT number on a single invoice."
This quote is directly taken from the notes.

Four short prompts, each small enough to be read properly. This is the idea behind map-reduce summarising
and, in a later case file, retrieval.
In a 2,048 token window LANTERN saw a sixth of the notes and said Northwind was never mentioned. In an
8,192 token window the whole file fitted, and it still missed the line in the middle. Cutting the middle
out made sure of it. Read in four pieces, the entry from 6 February surfaced: "Northwind is not a
vendor. It has no ships, no staff and no office, only a PO box in Port Sabran." Every payment, Reyes
wrote, was coded to Raj Malhotra's cost centre and dated while Malhotra was in Port Sabran.
Varma reads it twice. "He knew five weeks before he died. Who else did?"
